name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A stack of disclosures on Black: neutral hairlines between the rows, a DM Sans question, a muted answer that opens in place and a chevron that turns. One open at a time, or several.
use_for: Questions on a pricing or help page, filters a person opens one by one, settings that would crowd a view.
never: Hiding the one thing a person came for: put it on the page
A #171717 card per row: rows are hairlines on Black
A chevron that moves on hover
source: Derived from the guidelines: Black ground, neutral hairlines, DM Sans for body text. shadcn's accordion for anatomy, ARIA and keys.

examples.name: Faq
examples.label: Questions
examples.content:
<!-- Questions on a pricing page, one open at a time; the first opens with the page. -->
<spyglass-accordion value="what" class="w-160 max-w-full">
  <spyglass-accordion-item value="what" heading="What is Spyglass?">The only creative search engine. Ask in words for ads, product shots and UGC, and see what is running.</spyglass-accordion-item>
  <spyglass-accordion-item value="price" heading="How much does it cost?">$10 for your first month, then $20/month.</spyglass-accordion-item>
  <spyglass-accordion-item value="boards" heading="Can I share a board with my team?">Yes. Save creatives to a board and send the link to Acme's whole team.</spyglass-accordion-item>
</spyglass-accordion>

examples.name: Multiple
examples.label: Several open
examples.content:
<!-- Several rows open at once, for filters a person compares side by side; the last is not available yet. -->
<spyglass-accordion multiple value='["format","platform"]' class="w-120 max-w-full">
  <spyglass-accordion-item value="format" heading="Format">Video, carousel, static image.</spyglass-accordion-item>
  <spyglass-accordion-item value="platform" heading="Platform">Meta, TikTok, YouTube.</spyglass-accordion-item>
  <spyglass-accordion-item value="spend" heading="Estimated spend" disabled>Coming soon.</spyglass-accordion-item>
</spyglass-accordion>
